name: team-local
description: The team workflow on local Lemonade models only (Cline + provider lemonade, no cloud anywhere): GLM-4.7-Flash builds and plans, Gemma-4-12B (another family, with vision) reviews, same-model rework for 3 rounds, then the fallback dev model Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP takes the task over on a sibling card (started at once); only when the fallback fails too does the card go to the orchestrator. Every route (dev, plan, QA, fallback) is vetted (kanban models vet, 2026-10-09)

dev.note: Cline on the dev tier's pick (GLM-4.7-Flash, vetted for dev 2026-10-09)

qa.note: Gemma-4-12B (vetted for QA 2026-10-09): another family (google) than every dev model, with vision, so it reads screenshots; replaced Devstral, which stalled twice as notes' QA

plan.note: plans run on the dev tier's model in Cline's plan mode (--plan), so a plan card needs no model swap

fallback.note: fallback dev model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP, a third family, vetted for dev 2026-10-09) on the dev role's agent

candidates.note: in use (vetted for plan 2026-10-09): the dev model, so a plan card needs no model swap
candidate; 128K context as Lemonade loads it

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (the dev tier's model) in Cline's plan mode (--plan).

fallback.note: Same structure as team: after reworkRounds FAILs, a QA stall, an unchanged rework or an unresolved conflict the fallback sibling starts at once (local runs cost 0). Outages are waited out and then go to the orchestrator: every model is on the same Lemonade server, so a fallback can't get around its outage.

dev.note: dev pick (vetted 2026-10-09): tool-calling, a 30B-A3B MoE so it is fast on the one GPU, MLA attention so its KV cache is small (131072 context ≈ 7 GB), and already Cline's Lemonade default. The memory budget assumes Lemonade loads it at 131072 (its max is 202752)
candidate: coding + tool-calling labels, 131072 context; dense 24B, slower. Calibration v11 saw it answer with <run_commands> text instead of native tool calls
the fallback dev model (tier senior), vetted for dev: tool-calling + vision, 131072 context as Lemonade loads it
candidate, untested: a custom import with the tool-calling label and a 1M context (the KV cache at that size may not fit next to anything else)

qa.note: QA pick (vetted 2026-10-09): another family (google) than the GLM dev and Qwen fallback models, vision + tool-calling, small (12B, 6.8 GB); 131072 context, and its KV cache is small (8 of 48 layers full attention)
provisional: stalled twice as notes' QA (2026-10-09, no output); text-only, a dense 24B with a large KV cache (160 KB/token)
candidate (provisional for QA): the only vision model that is also strong at code; it is the fallback dev model, so it can't review a fallback sibling

senior.note: fallback dev model (escalate.to, vetted for dev 2026-10-09): a third family (Qwen), neither the GLM dev model nor the Gemma QA model, so its sibling is still reviewed by Gemma. Started without approval (local runs cost 0); the core never hands a task onto the card's own model and sends a fallback sibling that fails to the orchestrator, so the takeover happens once

tierRules.dev: Lemonade models with the tool-calling label; cost 0
tierRules.qa: a different vendor (model family) than the dev model
tierRules.senior: the fallback dev model: a family other than dev and QA

tierNotes.dev: Memory budget (one GPU: Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 96 GB GPU-addressable of 125 GB RAM): dev + QA + fallback must stay resident side by side within 80 GB, leaving 16 GB headroom. Estimate at the contexts Lemonade loads them with (weights = Lemonade's size; KV cache f16 from each model's config): GLM-4.7-Flash at 131072 = 16.3 + 7.1 (MLA, 54 KB/token) = 23.4 GB; Gemma-4-12B at 131072 = 6.8 + 2.1 (8 of 48 layers full attention with 1 KV head of 512, 16 KB/token) + 0.3 (40 sliding-window layers, 1024 tokens) = 9.2 GB; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at 131072 = 22.1 + 2.6 (10 of 40 layers full attention, 20 KB/token) = 24.7 GB; plus ~1.5 GB compute buffers each: about 62 GB. GLM at Lemonade's max context (202752) adds about 4 GB: keep it at 131072 (lemonade load <model> --ctx-size <n> --llamacpp vulkan --save-options) and Lemonade's max_loaded_models at 3. kanban bench calibrate can still compare candidates
tierNotes.qa: requireDifferentVendor reads the family from the model id (GLM → zai, Devstral → mistral, Qwen → qwen, Gemma → google, DeepSeek → deepseek)

settings.why: Lemonade/llama.cpp ends Cline turns without the TaskComplete hook; only the turn detector in mode on ends them (report only logs), or every card sits running with an idle TUI

local models need recovery to act: a no-images rejection or an overflowing context is cleared (/clear) and resent, and a Lemonade outage (connection refused, /health down) is held and probed instead of escalated
recovery must not be switched off for this project
